partition_role: System Main / user-space camera services and image framework
source_policy: Derived file metadata, ELF symbol metadata, direct dependency metadata, and bounded role annotations only; proprietary ELF files and binary payloads remain private.

layers.role: Camera color/image settings, system-event parameter processing, and image filters
layers.confidence: confirmed as a static control boundary
layers.limitation: The runtime process owner and downstream image-engine callers are not yet mapped.

layers.role: UI/model conversion for creative style, white balance, image quality, and image size
layers.confidence: confirmed as a static setting boundary
layers.limitation: These wrappers expose setting translation; they are not evidence of pixel-processing implementation.

layers.role: Shared YC/raw/effect/image-size/output-timing records and pin messaging
layers.confidence: confirmed as a static data contract
layers.limitation: Pin IDs, message layouts, and complete producer/consumer graph remain unresolved.

layers.role: Image-instance memory operations, parse/raw-parse, and dataflow image metadata
layers.confidence: confirmed as a static image-buffer boundary
layers.limitation: The raw buffer format and sensor/ISP handoff are unknown.

layers.role: Still encode, still write/read/playback, RAW development, record definition, and XvYCC metadata
layers.confidence: confirmed as a static media boundary
layers.limitation: The caller chain into the image engine and the exact encode parameter structures need REA tracing.

layers.role: Named still/movie codec, noise-reduction, sharpening, detection, panorama, and coefficient payloads
layers.confidence: confirmed as a payload inventory; processing roles are name-based
layers.limitation: The payload loader, instruction set, parameter blocks, and runtime mode selection are not yet recovered.

layers.role: External RAW scenario and diagnostic raw-YC/JPEG/display capture commands
layers.limitation: Ordinary saved RAW/JPEG production has not been connected to these paths.

layers.role: JPEG/live-view retrieval and network content delivery
layers.limitation: These libraries do not prove ownership of demosaic, color conversion, or JPEG encoding.
